content.text:
I fixed all three problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` passes (6 of 6, including 4 new regression tests).

- **Hang after a failure:** the old code never decremented `running` when a job rejected, so the slot stayed taken. A job that threw synchronously or returned a plain value also broke it, because `fn().then` assumed a promise. Now every job is wrapped, so a sync throw becomes a rejection and a plain value is accepted. `running` is released whatever the outcome, and a failing job rejects only its own promise.
- **`onIdle()` resolving early:** it only checked that nothing was pending. It now also requires that nothing is running.
- **One job at a time after `resume()`:** `next()` started at most one job per call. It is now a loop that fills every free slot, so `resume()` starts up to `concurrency` jobs.

The new tests in `test/queue.test.js` cover:
- a failing job (both async and sync throws) not stopping the queue
- `onIdle()` waiting for running jobs
- `onIdle()` resolving straight away when the queue is already idle
- `resume()` refilling all four slots after a pause

I haven't committed anything.
